core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hatice is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Khadija (Turkish form)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hatice corresponds to the Arabic form خَدِيجَة (Arabic root خ د ج (kh-d-j); خَدِيجَة (Khadīja)). Its core sense is hatice; khadija (turkish form). Hatice is the Turkish form of Arabic خَدِيجَة (Khadīja), the name of the Prophet's first wife.
